## [1.0.2](https://github.com/Hari-sys786/telegram-patches/compare/v1.0.1...v1.0.2) (2026-09-15)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Toolchain:** build the bundle against `morphe-patcher` **1.8.0** (Gradle 9.6.1, `app.morphe.patches`
  plugin 1.3.3) instead of 1.11.0. The bundle manifest advertises its patcher version, and Morphe
  refuses to load a bundle built for a newer patcher than the manager ships — the previous bundle
  (`Patcher-Version: 1.11.0`) was therefore not offered by the manager at all. 1.8.0 matches the
  reference Morphe sources that load correctly everywhere.

patches.name: Access banned channels
patches.description: Makes every MessagesController.checkCanOpenChat(...) overload always return true.

patches.name: Allow forwarding/saving restricted media
patches.description: Makes MessagesController.isChatNoForwards(...) always return false.

patches.name: Bypass isRestrictedMessage
patches.description: Forces every read of the isRestrictedMessage field to false.

patches.name: Delete Account dialog
patches.description: Adds a Settings entry that opens a Cherrygram-style Delete Account dialog (red 20s countdown, deletes all dialogs, calls account.deleteAccount, then logs out).

patches.name: Disable marking stories as read
patches.description: Makes StoriesController.markStoryAsRead(...) always return false so watched stories are not marked read.

patches.name: Disable signature verification
patches.description: Forces AndroidUtilities.getCertificateSHA256Fingerprint() to return the mod's known certificate SHA-256 so the official Telegram build can run after a repack.

patches.name: Disable sponsored messages (client flag)
patches.description: Makes MessagesController.isSponsoredDisabled() always return true.

patches.name: Enable saving media everywhere
patches.description: Forces every read of the noforwards field to false.

patches.name: Enable screenshots
patches.description: Removes FLAG_SECURE everywhere (window flags, allowScreenCapture, allowScreenshots, secret media viewers).

patches.name: Force premium (PremiumPreviewFragment.forcePremium)
patches.description: Forces every read of PremiumPreviewFragment.forcePremium to true.

patches.name: Force premium (StoriesController.isPremium)
patches.description: Makes StoriesController.isPremium(long) always return true so stories premium features are unlocked.

patches.name: Force premium (UserConfig.isPremium)
patches.description: Makes UserConfig.isPremium() always return true.

patches.name: Force premium feature available
patches.description: Makes isPremiumFeatureAvailable(...) report available by flipping its false constant to true.

patches.name: Hide sponsored messages
patches.description: Makes MessageObject.isSponsored() always return false.

patches.name: Increase download speed
patches.description: Raises FileLoadOperation.updateParams() chunk size (0x20000 -> 0x80000) and max requests (4 -> 8).

patches.name: Increase upload speed
patches.description: Raises FileUploadOperation's inlined throughput cap (0x800 -> 0x2000) so Telegram uses up to 4x more parallel upload parts (maxRequestsCount).

patches.name: Raise max account count (999)
patches.description: Makes UserConfig.getMaxAccountCount() return 999 instead of 3/5, removing the stock limit on the number of accounts that can be added.

patches.name: Remove proxy sponsored channels
patches.description: Empties MessagesController.checkPromoInfoInternal(boolean) so no promo channel request is made.

patches.name: Secret media enabler
patches.description: Prevents secret media from expiring and disables the secret-media checks.

patches.name: Unlock premium-locked content
patches.description: Forces every read of the premiumLocked field to false.
